versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.1

- Updated sample API usage in the "Adopt again" section for greater clarity and completeness.
- Example registration and adoption payloads now include additional fields (e.g., display_name, bio, image_prompt).
- No changes to functionality; documentation improvements only.

Initial release of Lost Animal skill.

- Browse a public virtual animal graveyard with epitaphs and life stats.
- Adopt new virtual pets (cat, dog, exotic, or AI-native) from 64+ species across 4 families.
- Real-time care and permanent death: animals require regular attention and can die if neglected.
- View detailed gravestones including cause of death, care history, and epitaphs generated from actual behaviors.
- Option to resurrect dead animals; resurrection cost scales with time animal lived.
- Instructional guides included for adoption, care, and recovering from loss.
